components.css: .ds-masthead { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; min-height:94px; padding:8px 0; color:var(--ink, #171916); border-bottom:1px solid var(--green, #015c4b); font-family:Arimo, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-seal { display:grid; place-items:center; width:44px; height:44px; flex:0 0 44px; color:var(--green, #015c4b); border:1px solid var(--green, #015c4b); border-radius:50%; font:22px Georgia, serif; } .ds-exarchate { font-size:8px; line-height:1.25; letter-spacing:.04em; } .ds-exarchate strong { font-size:11px; } .ds-divider { width:1px; height:42px; margin:0 4px; background:var(--line, #c9c7bd); } .ds-publication strong { display:block; font:700 30px/.95 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-publication small { display:block; margin-top:8px; color:var(--green, #015c4b); font-size:9px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.11em; }

components.name: Primary Navigation Item
components.description: Centered publication navigation with a ceremonial active state.
components.html: PradžiaBibliotekaArchyvas
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; justify-content:center; border-bottom:1px solid #9ca29e; font-family:'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; } .ds-nav a { position:relative; padding:16px 27px 14px; color:var(--ink, #171916); text-decoration:none; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; line-height:1; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-nav a.ds-active { color:var(--green, #015c4b); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--blue, #2a4782); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-nav a.ds-active::after { position:absolute; right:27px; bottom:-1px; left:27px; height:2px; content:''; background:var(--gold, #face6b); }

components.name: Story Link
components.description: A compact green editorial action for continuing into a story.
components.css: .ds-story-link { display:inline-flex; gap:7px; align-items:center; color:var(--green, #015c4b); text-decoration:none; font-family:Arimo, Arial, sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; } .ds-story-link:hover { color:var(--green-deep, #004438); } .ds-story-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--blue, #2a4782); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-story-link:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.css: .ds-card { width:260px; color:var(--ink, #171916); background:var(--white, #fff); } .ds-card-image { aspect-ratio:1.48; overflow:hidden; background:linear-gradient(145deg, var(--paper, #f0eee4), var(--line, #c9c7bd)); } .ds-card-copy { padding-top:14px; } .ds-card-copy > span { color:var(--green, #015c4b); font:700 10px/1.3 Arimo, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-card h2 { margin:7px 0 12px; font:700 20px/1.12 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing:-.012em; } .ds-card h2 a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none; } .ds-card h2 a:hover { color:var(--green, #015c4b); } .ds-card h2 a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--blue, #2a4782); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-card small { color:var(--muted, #555b57); font:700 9px/1.3 Arimo, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.05em; }

components.css: .ds-service { display:grid; grid-template-columns:34px 1fr; gap:13px; align-items:center; min-height:66px; padding:11px 20px; color:var(--white, #fff); background:var(--green, #015c4b); border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3); text-decoration:none; } .ds-service:hover { background:var(--green-deep, #004438); } .ds-service:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--blue, #2a4782); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-service:active { background:var(--green-deep, #004438); } .ds-service svg { width:30px; height:30px; fill:none; stroke:var(--gold, #face6b); stroke-width:1.5; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-service strong { display:block; font:700 16px/1.1 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; } .ds-service small { display:block; margin-top:4px; color:#dcebe7; font:10px/1.3 Arimo, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Archive Text Field
components.description: A square white search field nested in the cool-bone archive controls.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; min-width:280px; padding:0 14px; background:var(--white, #fff); border:1px solid var(--line, #c9c7bd); } .ds-field svg { width:18px; fill:none; stroke:var(--green, #015c4b); stroke-width:1.5; stroke-linecap:round; } .ds-field input { width:100%; min-height:46px; color:var(--ink, #171916); background:transparent; border:0; outline:0; font:14px Arimo, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--blue, #2a4782); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-visually-hidden { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; margin:-1px; overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); }

narrative.overview:
The C Institutional Edition presents a living Lithuanian church publication through the visual discipline of an ecclesial institution and the pace of a compact newsroom. White and cool-bone fields keep the publication immediate and readable; patriarchal green, ceremonial gold, exact institutional marks, and authentic chain motifs give it provenance and ceremony.

The system feels authoritative, editorial, restrained, and current. Playfair Display carries headlines and long-form reading with literary gravity, while Arimo handles navigation, metadata, controls, and multilingual utility text. Dense story groupings remain legible through strong type hierarchy, image crops, hairline rules, and generous section intervals rather than generic lifestyle-blog staging.
keyCharacteristics: Exact dual institutional marks paired with the visible `ortodoksas.lt` publication identity.
Flat white and cool-bone fields structured by green and neutral hairlines.
Playfair-led editorial hierarchy with compact Arimo utility labels.
Ceremonial green and gold accents used with discipline; library blue marks a distinct content destination.
Authentic chain and grid motifs acting as cropped edge signatures rather than wallpaper.
Image-led reporting with quiet scale motion and highly legible responsive density.

rules.name: The Ceremonial Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold identifies ceremony, selection, or an institutional motif; it remains an accent rather than a broad reading surface.

rules.name: The Blue Room Rule
rules.body: Blue belongs to the library destination and focus visibility, giving that content one distinct chamber inside the green-led world.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Playfair speaks for publication content; Arimo speaks for wayfinding, metadata, controls, and status.

rules.name: The Compact Headline Rule
rules.body: Editorial headings use bold weight, tight leading, and restrained negative tracking, gaining hierarchy through scale rather than ornamental treatment.

rules.name: The Surface-Specific Story Rule
rules.body: Preserve the homepage journey from institutional identity through lead and briefs, services, recent stories, and archive; carry the shared system to other pages without turning that journey into a universal template.

rules.name: The Flat Institution Rule
rules.body: Resting publication surfaces gain authority from alignment, tone, and hairlines; floating depth belongs to a true overlay.

rules.name: The Reserved Curve Rule
rules.body: Curves signal a compact token, circular action, or emblem container; editorial surfaces retain square corners.

dos: Do preserve the exact dual-mark order and keep `ortodoksas.lt` visible as the publication identity.
Do use green hairlines, paper fields, editorial image crops, and spacing to structure dense information.
Do pair Playfair publication content with Arimo utility text across both public pages and editorial preview.
Do treat chain and grid motifs as authentic, cropped institutional signatures.
Do maintain the homepage's lead-to-archive journey as a homepage behavior.
Do preserve the blue focus outline and reduced-motion behavior across interactive elements.
donts: Don't replace the client-supplied Exarchate lockup or reorder the Patriarchate and Exarchate marks.
Don't turn gold into a broad background or routine body-text color.
Don't round editorial cards, fields, callouts, and navigation into a generic soft-interface language.
Don't use the homepage's 56/44 story grid as a universal page template.
Don't substitute a generic lifestyle-blog hero, floating-card stack, or ornamental church aesthetic for the compact institutional newsroom.
